description: This file defines a Java interface named RecurringDepositProductWritePlatformService for handling create, update, and delete operations related to recurring deposit products within the Fineract system.

classes.name: RecurringDepositProductWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for performing write operations (create, update, delete) on recurring deposit products.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new recurring deposit product using the provided command.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing recurring deposit product identified by productId.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the recurring deposit product identified by productId.
